stageRules: Merge component service fitted once per consumer, including peer/relay routes without folding network into merge.
Initial workspace scan is moved from runtime overhead to preparation, exactly once.
Network-route residual cannot be interpreted as input scan; direct scan telemetry is required for cloud.
Different runtime drivers cannot be mixed in a single class calibration.
Training workspace projection uses actual training resource types, not holdout placement.
Canonical activity names align historical IDs exactly; no family-only joins.
Fixed placement evaluator updates PRISM forecast without changing resource/core/order.

cases.scope: mixed cloud e2-micro / HPC Slurm; cloud stage calibration

toleranceDefinition: For the user target, check abs(real - predicted) / predicted <= 0.25. Report reference-denominator accuracy separately; do not interchange them.
remaining: Dominant activity residuals still too large; aggregate agreement alone does not establish validation.
Need an independent holdout with e2-medium before claiming that class meets tolerance.
Cloud training and holdout use different runtime-era overheads; profiles must carry provenance and confidence.
Remaining effective-wall publication/preparation coefficients contain unidentified waiting; distinguish CPU/IO service from channel queue before accepting contention model.
Recovered cloud/HPC run must not be used as clean makespan holdout.
